skills.name: Double Jump
skills.description: Mid-air second jump for vertical mobility and exploration. The single most impactful skill point in the game.

skills.name: Blink
skills.description: Short-range teleport that replaces dodge roll. Crosses gaps, escapes danger, repositions instantly.

skills.name: Updraft
skills.description: Jump higher using stamina. Stacks with Double Jump for extreme vertical reach.

skills.name: Water Aura
skills.description: Passive AoE healing for you and nearby allies. Essential for solo sustain and group support.

skills.name: Dessert Stomach
skills.description: Unlocks a 4th food slot. More food buffs = more stats simultaneously.

skills.name: Battle Heal
skills.description: Active self-heal on demand. Your emergency button for boss fights.

skills.name: Miner
skills.description: Increased pickaxe damage. Faster mining = more resources in less time.

skills.name: Airborne
skills.description: Bonus damage while in the air. Pairs perfectly with Double Jump + Updraft.

skills.name: Begone!
skills.description: Knockback wave that pushes enemies away. Emergency crowd control.

skills.name: Rebound
skills.description: Reflects incoming damage back at attackers. Strong defensive layer.

skills.name: Shell Shock
skills.description: AoE stun on parry/block break. Opens enemies for Merciless Strike follow-up.

skills.name: Emergency Blink
skills.description: Auto-blink when taking lethal damage. A free second chance on a cooldown.

skills.name: Iron Skin
skills.description: Flat physical damage reduction. Core for melee and tank builds.

skills.name: Runner
skills.description: Increased sprint speed and reduced stamina drain. Exploration quality of life.

skills.name: Endurance
skills.description: Increased max stamina. More dodges, blocks, and sprints.

skills.name: Vitality
skills.description: Increased max HP. More survivability for any build.

skills.name: Jump Attack
skills.description: Aerial slam with AoE damage. Pairs with Double Jump + Airborne.

skills.name: Merciless Strike
skills.description: Heavy finisher on stunned/knocked enemies. Massive single-target damage.

skills.name: Headhunter
skills.description: Bonus damage on headshots. Core for any bow/crossbow build.

skills.name: Arcane Empowerment
skills.description: Increased magic damage. Foundation for all mage DPS builds.

skills.name: Pyromancy
skills.description: Fire damage bonus. Pairs with Scorching Wand and fire-based staves.

skills.name: Beast Master
skills.description: Tamed creatures deal more damage. Niche but powerful for summoner playstyle.

skills.name: Eagle Eye
skills.description: Increased zoom and accuracy with ranged weapons.

skills.name: Heavy Hitter
skills.description: Increased 2H weapon damage. Core for Barbarian/Greatsword builds.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: Charged fireball projectile with AoE explosion. Bread-and-butter mage spell.

skills.name: Bulwark
skills.description: Increased block stability. Less stamina drain when blocking.

skills.name: Juggernaut
skills.description: Cannot be staggered during heavy attacks. Essential for 2H playstyle.

skills.name: Quickdraw
skills.description: Faster bow draw speed. Higher DPS for archer builds.

skills.name: Crossbow Expert
skills.description: Faster crossbow reload. Critical for crossbow main builds.

skills.name: Shadow Step
skills.description: Brief invisibility after Blink. Enables stealth repositioning mid-combat.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.description: Massive bonus damage from stealth openers. Core for assassin playstyle.

skills.name: Mana Font
skills.description: Increased mana regeneration. Sustained casting for longer fights.

skills.name: Elemental Affinity
skills.description: Elemental damage bonus based on equipped staff/wand element.

skills.name: Arcane Surge
skills.description: Temporary magic power boost on a cooldown. Burst DPS window.

skills.name: Shroud Affinity
skills.description: Shroud magic bonus. Pairs with Shroud Staff for poison/shadow builds.

skills.name: Catalyst
skills.description: Reduced staff charge time. Faster spell casting.

skills.name: Scout
skills.description: Increased detection range for resources and enemies. Exploration utility.

skills.name: Evasion
skills.description: Brief invincibility frames on dodge. Skill-based defense for light armor builds.

skills.name: Steady Hands
skills.description: Reduced weapon sway while aiming. Accuracy for ranged weapons.

skills.name: Aerial Strikes
skills.description: Bonus damage on all aerial attacks. Pairs with airborne combat style.

skills.name: Emergency Supplies
skills.description: Chance to not consume consumables on use. Saves resources over time.

skills.name: Elemental Mastery
skills.description: All elemental damage types increased. Broad magic damage boost.

skills.name: Poison Cloud
skills.description: AoE poison field. Damage over time for area control.

skills.name: Frost Magic
skills.description: Frost damage bonus + slow effect on enemies. Utility over raw damage.

skills.name: Overcharge
skills.description: Next spell deals double damage but costs double mana. Burst tool.

skills.name: Mana Reservoir
skills.description: Increased max mana. Bigger mana pool for longer fights.

skills.name: Last Stand
skills.description: Damage resistance when below 30% HP. Survival clutch passive.

skills.name: Retaliation
skills.description: Thorns effect — reflect damage to attackers. Passive DPS for tanks.

skills.name: Headhunter Mastery
skills.description: Even more headshot damage. Overkill for most content.

skills.name: Survival Instinct
skills.description: Increased stats when solo. Good for solo play, useless in groups.

skills.name: Sneak Attack
skills.description: Bonus damage from stealth. Very situational — most fights start open.
